cases.name: viewport-fill
cases.claim: The embedded app root occupies the profile viewport through an explicit percentage-height chain.
cases.remediation: Define html/body/#root and the app shell height chain; assign exactly one bounded scroll region.

cases.name: chrome-declaration-and-render-alignment
cases.claim: Declared theme/status chrome metadata matches the rendered top safe-area surface.
cases.remediation: Declare theme-color, viewport-fit, and mobile status metadata that matches the shell's top surface.

cases.name: changes-scroll-restoration
cases.claim: Changes scroll position is restored after Changes → Diff → Changes once list layout is ready.
cases.remediation: Persist and restore the owned list scroller after content readiness, not the document viewport.

cases.name: selection-toolbar-scroll-behavior
cases.claim: The selection toolbar belongs to Changes content and scrolls away with the selected rows.
cases.remediation: Keep selection controls in the owned content flow instead of making them sticky.

cases.name: diff-action-footer-placement
cases.claim: Mobile diff actions are bounded by the panel footer and remain reachable without covering diff content.
cases.remediation: Place diff actions in a constrained footer inside the selected panel.

cases.name: bottom-nav-geometry
cases.claim: Bottom navigation stays within the viewport, honors the safe area, and does not overlap the active panel's reachable content.
cases.remediation: Reserve a structural bottom-nav row and safe-area padding in the mobile shell.
